regimes.R0: meteorology, wind direction, rain occurrence, calendar and masks; no pollutant history
regimes.R1: R0 plus target-station PM2.5 history, its mask and its gap age
regimes.R2: R1 plus co-pollutant history (PM10, SO2, NO2, CO, O3) with masks and gap ages

causality_rules.rolling_pm25_reveal: permitted once a timestamp becomes past relative to the forecast origin
